title: Nunchi-Bench: Benchmarking Language Models on Cultural Reasoning with a Focus on Korean Superstition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to scenarios involving Korean superstitions using Multiple-Choice, Trap, and Interpretation questions to assess factual knowledge, culturally appropriate advice, and situational interpretation.
Comparing model performance on cultural reasoning tasks when prompted in English versus Korean to assess how the language of the prompt affects the model's cultural sensitivity and reasoning.
